# Introduction

In this analysis, I try running symEBcovMF on the celseq2 subset of the pancreas dataset. What differentiates this analysis from my previous analysis is I use the stability selection procedure to identify "stable" components.

# Packages
```{r}
library(ashr)
library(ebnm)
# pkgload::load_all('~/Documents/GitHub/ebnm')
library(Matrix)
library(fastTopics)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(flashier)
```

# Load in the Data
```{r}
load('~/single_cell_analyses/data/pancreas.RData')
```

```{r}
set.seed(1)

# Select the CEL-seq2 data (Muraro et al, 2016).
# This should select 2,285 cells.
i           <- which(sample_info$tech == "celseq2")
sample_info <- sample_info[i,]
counts      <- counts[i,]
celltype <- sample_info$celltype
celltype <-
 factor(celltype,
        c("acinar","ductal","activated_stellate","quiescent_stellate",
          "endothelial","macrophage","mast","schwann","alpha","beta",
          "delta","gamma","epsilon"))


# Remove genes that are expressed in fewer than 10 cells.
x      <- colSums(counts > 0)
j      <- which(x > 9)
counts <- counts[,j]

# Compute the shifted log counts.
a <- 1
s <- rowSums(counts)
s <- s/mean(s)
Y <- MatrixExtra::mapSparse(counts/(a*s),log1p)

# S <- (1/ncol(Y))*tcrossprod(Y)
```

# Split the data
```{r}
dim(Y)
```

```{r}
set.seed(1)
subset1 <- sample(1:ncol(Y), ncol(Y)/2)
subset2 <- setdiff(1:ncol(Y), subset1)
```

```{r}
S1 <- (1/ncol(Y[,subset1]))*tcrossprod(Y[,subset1])
S2 <- (1/ncol(Y[,subset2]))*tcrossprod(Y[,subset2])
```

# Simplified GBCD on subset 1

```{r pt_laplace_fit}
pancreas_cov_fit_subset1 <- flash_init(data = S1) |>
  flash_set_verbose(2) |>
  flash_greedy(Kmax = 10, ebnm_fn = ebnm::ebnm_point_laplace) |>
  flash_backfit(extrapolate = FALSE, warmstart = TRUE, maxiter = 200)
```

```{r}
diag(cor(pancreas_cov_fit_ptlaplace_scaled_subset1$L, pancreas_cov_fit_ptlaplace_scaled_subset1$F))
```

```{r split_function}
split_pt_laplace_estimates <- function(cov_fit){
  # S is the scaled Gram matrix
  # cov_fit is a flash object
  
  LL <- cov_fit$L_pm
  FF <- cov_fit$F_pm
  
# split into positive and negative components
  LL <- cbind(pmax(LL, 0), pmax(-LL, 0))
  FF <- cbind(pmax(FF, 0), pmax(-FF, 0))
  
  # remove columns of zeros
  LL.idx.nonzero <- apply(LL, 2, function(x){return(sum(x^2))}) > 10^(-10)
  FF.idx.nonzero <- apply(FF, 2, function(x){return(sum(x^2))}) > 10^(-10)
  LL <- LL[, LL.idx.nonzero]
  FF <- FF[, FF.idx.nonzero]
  
  # refit weights by least squares
  # n <- nrow(S)
  # lft_vec <- matrix(rep(0, ncol(LL)*n*n), ncol = ncol(LL))
  # for (i in 1:ncol(LL)){
  #   lft_vec[,i] <- c(LL[,i]%*%t(FF[,i]))
  # }
  # 
  # nnlm_fit <- NNLM::nnlm(lft_vec, as.matrix(c(S), ncol = 1), alpha = c(0,0,0))
  # 
  # indices_keep <- (nnlm_fit$coefficients > 0)
  # LL_scaled <- LL[,indices_keep] %*% diag(sqrt(nnlm_fit$coefficients[indices_keep]))
  # FF_scaled <- FF[,indices_keep] %*% diag(sqrt(nnlm_fit$coefficients[indices_keep]))
  return(list(LL, FF))
}
```

```{r pt_laplace_split_init}
pt_laplace_split_initialization <- split_pt_laplace_estimates(pancreas_cov_fit_subset1)
```

```{r gb_fit}
pancreas_cov_gb_fit_subset1 <- flash_init(data = S1) |>
  flash_set_verbose(2) |>
  flash_factors_init(pt_laplace_split_initialization, ebnm_fn = ebnm_point_exponential) |>
  flash_backfit(extrapolate = FALSE, warmstart = TRUE, maxiter = 100)
```

# Stability Selection

```{r}
# stability selection code
compute_cosine_sim_matrix <- function(L1, L2){
  norms1 <- apply(L1, 2, function(x){sqrt(sum(x^2))})
  norms1[norms1 < 10^(-15)] <- Inf
  
  norms2 <- apply(L2, 2, function(x){sqrt(sum(x^2))})
  norms2[norms2 < 10^(-15)] <- Inf
  
  L1_normalized <- t(t(L1)/norms1)
  L2_normalized <- t(t(L2)/norms2)
  
  #compute matrix of cosine similarities
  cosine_sim_matrix <- crossprod(L1_normalized, L2_normalized)
  
  return(cosine_sim_matrix)
}

stability_selection_post_processing <- function(L1, L2, threshold=0.99){
  
  # compute similarity
  cosine_sim_matrix <- compute_cosine_sim_matrix(L1, L2)
  
  assignment_problem <- RcppHungarian::HungarianSolver(-1*cosine_sim_matrix)
  pairings <- assignment_problem$pairs
  
  # remove things that were not paired
  no_pair <- pairings[,2] == 0
  pairings <- pairings[!(no_pair), , drop = FALSE]
  
  # filter pairings
  pairing_similarities <- cosine_sim_matrix[pairings]
  pairings.keep <- pairing_similarities > threshold
  pairings <- pairings[pairings.keep, , drop = FALSE]
  # K <- nrow(pairings)
  
  # compute final estimate
  if (nrow(pairings) == 0){
    L_final <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(L1), ncol = 1)
  } else {
    paired_L <- list()
    paired_L[[1]] <- L1[, pairings[,1],drop = FALSE]
    paired_L[[2]] <- L2[, pairings[,2],drop=FALSE]
    paired_L_arr <- simplify2array(paired_L)
    L_final <- apply(paired_L_arr, 1:2, mean)
  }
  
  return(list(final_est = L_final, pairings = pairings))
}
```

## Threshold = 0.8
```{r}

```

# Look at the driving genes

```{r}
L_init <- L
F_init <- t(solve(crossprod(L_init), as.matrix(Matrix::crossprod(L_init, Y))))
```

```{r}
semi_nmf_fit <- flash_init(data = Y) |>
  flash_factors_init(init = list(L_init, F_init), ebnm_fn = c(ebnm_point_exponential, ebnm_point_laplace)) |>
  flash_factors_fix(kset = 1:ncol(L), which_dim = 'loadings') |>
  flash_backfit()
```

```{r}
# Peter's code
effect_plot <- function (effects_matrix, font_size = 9,
                         zero_value = 0.01) {
  features <- rownames(effects_matrix)
  pdat <- data.frame(feature_name = features,
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  pdat <- cbind(pdat,effects_matrix)
  pdat <- reshape2::melt(pdat,id.vars = "feature_name",variable.name = "dim",
               value.name = "value")
  pdat <- transform(pdat,
                    effect_size = abs(value),
                    effect_sign = factor(sign(value),c(-1,0,1)),
                    feature_name = factor(feature_name,rev(features)))
  pdat$effect_size[pdat$effect_size < zero_value] <- NA
  return(ggplot(pdat,aes(x = dim,y = feature_name,size = effect_size,
                         fill = effect_sign)) +
         geom_point(color = "white",shape = 21,na.rm = TRUE) +
         scale_size(range = c(1,6),
                    breaks = range(pdat$effect_size,na.rm = TRUE),
                    labels = round(range(pdat$effect_size,na.rm = TRUE),
                                   digits = 2)) +
         scale_fill_manual(values = c("navy","gray","orangered"),
                           drop = FALSE) +
         guides(size = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "black")),
                fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3))) +
         labs(x = "dimension",y = "feature name",
              fill = "effect sign",size = "effect size") +
         theme_cowplot(font_size = font_size))
}

select_driving_genes <- function (effect_matrix, dims, n,
                                  select_down_effects = TRUE) {
  genes <- NULL
  for (i in dims) {
    genes <- c(genes,head(order(effect_matrix[,i],decreasing = TRUE),n))
    if (select_down_effects)
      genes <- c(genes,head(order(effect_matrix[,i],decreasing = FALSE),n))
  }
  genes <- unique(genes)
  return(rownames(effect_matrix)[genes])
}
```

```{r}

```

## Table of Driving Genes
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
```

```{r}
# Function to get driving genes
select_driving_genes_v2 <- function (effect_matrix, dims, n,
                                  effects = 'up') {
  genes <- NULL
  for (i in dims) {
    if (effects == 'up'){
    genes <- c(genes,head(order(effect_matrix[,i],decreasing = TRUE),n))
    }
    if (effects == 'down')
      genes <- c(genes,head(order(effect_matrix[,i],decreasing = FALSE),n))
  }
  genes <- unique(genes)
  return(rownames(effect_matrix)[genes])
}
```

```{r}
# 2. Build the summary data frame for all factors
gene_table_df <- tibble(
  Factor = paste("Factor", 1:ncol(scaled_F)),
  Driving_genes = map_chr(1:ncol(scaled_F), ~ paste(select_driving_genes_v2(dims = .x, effect_matrix = scaled_F, n = 10, effects = 'up'), collapse = ", "))
)

# 3. Render directly to LaTeX
latex_output <- knitr::kable(
  gene_table_df,
  format = "latex",
  booktabs = FALSE,
  escape = TRUE,
  linesep = "\\hline\n",
  align = c("|l", ">{\\raggedright\\arraybackslash}p{11cm}|"),
  col.names = c("Factor", "Driving Genes"),
  caption = "Top driving genes per factor."
)

# Print the code to console or write directly to a .tex file
cat(latex_output)
```
